_doc: Canonical skill vocabulary. INGEST (forward): normalize an OggDude SkillKey or any display-name alias (lowercase + collapse non-alphanumerics) and match to `id`. RENDER (backward): id -> label. `group` is the FFG skill category. Seeded from SWItems.SKILL_KEY_TO_NAME; OggDude raw.skills.items is the authority (it carries a couple not in this static map) — reconcile and add them at ingest. Aliases capture the four spellings seen in the wild: key, paren ('Ranged (Light)'), dash ('Ranged - Light'), colon ('Ranged: Heavy'); Knowledge skills also carry their un-stripped 'Knowledge ...' forms.
